mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.quizzes (id, quiz_title, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, start_time, due_time, attempt_limited, course_id, student_id, teacher_id, display, lifecycle_status, source_type, original_quiz_id, version, published_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{quizTitle}, #{unlimited}, #{timeLimitMinutes}, #{passScore}, #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{attemptLimited}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{display}, #{lifecycleStatus, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizLifecycleStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{originalQuizId}, #{version}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW()) INSERT INTO edu.quizzes (id, quiz_title, description, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, start_time, due_time, attempt_limited, course_id, student_id, teacher_id, display, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{quizTitle}, #{description}, #{unlimited}, #{timeLimitMinutes}, #{passScore}, #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{attemptLimited}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{display}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.quizzes SET quiz_title = #{quizTitle}, description = #{description}, unlimited = #{unlimited}, time_limit_minutes = #{timeLimitMinutes}, pass_score = #{passScore}, start_time = #{startTime}, due_time = #{dueTime}, attempt_limited = #{attemptLimited}, course_id = #{courseId}, student_id = #{studentId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, display = #{display}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizLifecycleStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, source_type = #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, original_quiz_id = #{originalQuizId}, version = #{version}, published_by = #{publishedBy}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
